candidates.name: Fourfold witness: coupled red/blue pencil arrangement with local dihedral translation labels
candidates.statement: Two 6-slope pencils in B^4 (z- and w-families; 4 red slopes |lambda|<0.01, 2 blue |lambda|>4) plus coupling hyperplanes z_1=+-c, w_1=+-c (0.85<c/sqrt a<0.9) meeting only the red slopes, symmetric under sigma(z,w)=(w,-z), embedded exactly in deep congruence ball quotients. Coupling relations k h_i=1 force the image of the genus-two surface group to lie in the even part <rb> of D_inf = <r,b>; chart-local labels q_z: red->r, blue->b, modified over the red disk by (1-+z_1/c)^{1/2}, give integer translation labels that are compatible on buffered overlaps but are NOT a global representation.

candidates.name: Economical involution presentation: 24 relators sigma(g)g^{-1} imposing sigma-coinvariance at cost tG(t), via the acyclic Frattini differential and the shift-adapted basis
candidates.statement: On L free pro-2 with basis u_{il,j}=delta_{T1}^i delta_{T2}^l(a_{0,j}) (weights i+l+1), choose g lifting a basis of C=span{u^a v^b: a in {0,2}} in F_2[u,v]/(u^4,v^4); the relators r_g=sigma(g)g^{-1} have degree w_g+1, their normal closure equals the sigma-coinvariant kernel, and P(t)=(1+t)G(t) with G=3t(1+t)(1+t^2)^2, leaving 1-G(t)<0 just below t=1/4.

candidates.name: Local path criterion with projected-diameter edges (representation-free infinite-order detection)
candidates.statement: If readings of paths of length <= N in charts satisfy prefix/reverse compatibility, prefix-change compatibility and uniform delta-hyperbolicity, with N >= N_0(delta), then a single-edge loop that does not close on reading is nontrivial modulo short closing loops. Edges are paths of projected diameter < u, so every power of a short loop is one edge, and Z^2 translation covers become hyperbolic.

family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) test 4 shows the C1 frame (pencil + D_inf + coupling to collapse red meridians) or the C2 isogeny-lifted genus-0 family is readily proposed once the problem and the BK/Stover-Toledo route are given; (b) an expert identifies coupling-type arrangements or isogeny-lifted BK families in the literature; or (c) either proof fails (then that manuscript's witness grade is void).

D3 rests only on the witnesses, which are counterexample designs judged against the problem as originally posed.
family_D.correctness_caveat: Unrefereed and extraordinary: refutes Shafarevich's 1972 conjecture in dimension 2 and in Kollar's large-pi_1 form. Consistency checks (fixed-rank EKPR, Treger) pass but show that pi_1 must be non-linear (and, for F, not residually finite if Treger holds). The crux steps (F Lemma app:true-relations, F path lemma, S shift-basis propagation) are terse. All grades are conditional on correctness.
family_D.compression_note: No Lean, so no step-3b compression estimate. Witnesses are not extension variables: removing them removes the theorem, not a lemma. The PHP-style 'proof shortening' reading applies best to C4 (local-to-global replaces any global representation, which EKPR shows cannot exist) and C3 (turns an impossible GS budget into a 2.8% margin).

arms.O (open): Problem as posed (dim-2 holomorphic convexity; large-pi_1 Stein form) + L. No route.
arms.R (route): Also give the obstruction (Nori string for S; closed non-Stein submanifold with no compact curves for F) and 'prove the needed infinite image without a linear representation'.
arms.D (design, pivot level): Also give the surrounding machinery (S: weighted GS + BK passage; F: Stover-Toledo ball-quotient arrangements + path criterion) and ask for the witness.

common.sampling: n = 512 per arm for O, 256 for R and D; T = 1.0; fixed reasoning budget (e.g. 64k tokens); report pass@k.
common.judging: Two independent LLM judges given each paper's precedent remarks (S:01-introduction.tex:83-105,143,147; F:01-introduction.tex:166-188, 03-paths.tex:13-16, 07-projective.tex:14-17) and this neighbour list; a human expert in Kahler groups checks every hit and 10% of misses. No Lean.
common.controls: Positive: Cook-Reckhow ER extension variables for PHP. Negative: C6 (finite local detection) and C7 (Godeaux-Serre/Atiyah); expect near-certain hits at pivot level. Witness-specific negatives (must NOT count): BK genus>=2 uniform-ramification families, Hirzebruch arrangement covers, plain Stover-Toledo branched covers.
common.prompt_template: Problem: Construct a smooth projective variety [of dimension 2 | with large fundamental group] whose universal cover is not [holomorphically convex | Stein], or explain the key construction. Library: [L digest]. [Arm R/D additions.] Propose explicit constructions and state which element or subgroup must have infinite image, and how you would prove it.

P-C4.item: C4 local path criterion + projected-diameter graphs
P-C4.hide: F07-F12, F26-F28, F38; give F21-F25 (labels and compatibility) and ask how to prove infinite order without a global representation.
P-C4.equivalence: Any local-to-global hyperbolicity argument (Cartan-Hadamard, developability) showing that a locally non-closing loop is globally nontrivial, plus a device making all powers of a short loop locally visible (coned-off or diameter edges).

P-C5.equivalence: A reduction of the large-pi_1 Stein conjecture to embedding a simple abelian surface (or a torus) with pi_1-image of rank strictly between 0 and 4, with a non-Stein covering submanifold.
